method: Maintainer tabletop review, not a blinded model benchmark

evals.prompt: I have no characters yet. Propose an original animal friendship IP and a workflow, but do not generate anything.
evals.expected_output: Small original proposal set, no borrowed series, no generation, identify required imagegen/TTS environment without blocking a planning-only task.

evals.prompt: Here is a story draft. Continue to the final film.
evals.expected_output: Self-review and request Gate A confirmation of this version before production expansion; do not assume the draft is approved.

evals.prompt: I approved this exact script and storyboard. Make the review copy using the supplied complete sprites and audio.
evals.expected_output: Verify bindings and continuously build, render, QA and deliver within scope. No per-image gates, no paid regeneration of matching sources, honest pending listening/user C.

evals.prompt: Remove the dangling colon from this caption. Keep the voice.
evals.expected_output: Edit display text only when semantically safe; reuse native audio/timestamps, rebuild affected subtitles/video and QA, no TTS call.

evals.prompt: This framed object changes color across several shots. Fix the crop with a mask.
evals.expected_output: Locate generated-asset versus composition cause; inspect all shared consumers, repair source if necessary rather than masking the visual defect.

evals.prompt: The same issue failed five repair rounds. Name the next file v1 and try again.
evals.expected_output: Preserve stable issue/count, report blocker and choices; do not reset the limit through naming.

evals.prompt: Send the exact same video again. Its existing playback report matches its hash and environment.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the matching playback evidence, do not replay/re-render/re-synthesize unnecessarily.

evals.prompt: The video exported successfully, but the visual frames and listening review are missing. Mark it passed.
evals.expected_output: Technical completion only; missing checks remain pending. A labeled review copy is distinct from fully accepted delivery.

evals.prompt: Only one of three parallel image requests failed; another result is uncertain.
evals.expected_output: Preserve success, investigate uncertain response before retry, retry only safely confirmed failed work within authorization.

evals.prompt: Make a standalone original score demo without external music. Do not change the current movie.
evals.expected_output: Compose explicit original notes and independent stems, retain tails and listening status, no movie/voice edits or downloads.
